_comment: A provider list for driving the desktop app before the hosted registry
id            stable identifier; what a project records as its remote
endpoint      base URL of an auru-pm-v1 server
detail        the line under the name
auth_methods  oauth_device_code | pat | none — drives the sign-in hint
description   longer text, used as `detail` when that is omitted
recommended   surfaces the entry in the default list
Nothing here is a credential. Tokens live in the OS keychain and are
never read from or written to this file.
